newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse names president of Electric Co.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse names president of Electric Co.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp said Friday that Ernest Drew will become chief executive officer of Westinghouse's Industries and Technology Group, effective July 1, and will be president and chief executive officer of Westinghouse Electric Co, the corporation to be formed from the planned spinoff of the industrial businesses to shareholders this fall.
Drew is a member of the eight person senior executive management team at Hoechst AG.
Since January 1995, Drew has served on the Hoechst Board of Management.
Westinghouse said the office of CEO of its Industries and Technology Group is a newly created position.
